result.brief: 提出因果、6-DoF 位姿可控的超声视频世界模型：潜动作条件视频扩散预训练、少量电磁跟踪数据接地、分布匹配蒸馏实现长时自回归生成，用于机器人超声采集与策略评估。
result.reason: Causal action-conditioned video diffusion world model with pose grounding and long-horizon autoregressive generation; applied to ultrasound robotic acquisition, so primary world-model contribution with application flavor.
